kreator.imie.opis_migracja: Each person has their own game profiles and steps. Enter your name and your current settings go to your person.
kreator.imie.opis: This name is shown in the app. It was picked at random: roll again or type your own.
kreator.gra.opis: A game profile holds the control settings for one game. You can add more at any time.
kreator.gra.wskaz: Choose the game folder / WalkLevel takes the name, icon and colour from the game file
kreator.gra.kolor_z_ikony: The {kolor} colour comes from the game icon. Choose another with the Colour button.
kreator.gra.zostaw: Keep my current settings / The Default profile with your settings so far
kreator.gra.domyslny: Default profile / For any game. You can change its name and icon later.
kreator.gra.kopiuj_opis: With icons and settings. The step history of the new person starts from zero.
kreator.gra.brak_pliku: There is no game file in this folder. Choose the folder with the game .exe file.
kreator.tryb.tytul: How do you want to control?
kreator.tryb.opis: For the {profil} profile. You can change it in Settings > Games and controls.
kreator.tryb.klawisze: Keys / Hold W and the belt speeds up. Let go and it slows down.
kreator.tryb.pad: Gamepad / Tilting the stick sets the belt speed in a few gears.
kreator.tryb.chodzenie: Walking / You walk on the treadmill and your character walks in the game. The game gets W, and W + Shift at a faster pace.
kreator.tryb.trening: Training / Four fixed paces without a game. Pick a level by clicking or with F7 and F6.
